scope: A representative vertical slice: 2 ready-for-life lessons (one guardian-certified real-world task, one learner-authority lesson) and 2 financial-literacy lessons (one fixed-answer-key item, one judgment/reasoning item with a fixed model answer) per grade band, for grades 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, and HS grade 9 (representative of HS 9-12).

notCovered.remainingLessonsPerCourse: Each source course has 36 lessons (72 for grade-8 financial-literacy); only 2 per course are authored as production student-work here. The other 32-70 lessons per course are not yet built.
notCovered.hsGrades10to12: Only HS grade 9 is authored. Grades 10, 11, and 12 (curriculum-content 1.1.0) are not covered.
notCovered.reason: Scoped as a vertical slice demonstrating the full task-sheet + scoring + attestation + remediation/extension pattern at production quality across every requested grade band, rather than partially covering more lessons at lower fidelity. Extending coverage lesson-by-lesson is mechanical repetition of this same pattern, not open design work.
